---
applyTo: "packages/authn/test/**/*"
excludeAgent: cloud-agent
---
The `packages/authn/test/` directory contains human-maintained test suites that
enable test-driven-development by providing 100% coverage of the agent-owned
`packages/authn/src/` directory.

**Be adversarial.** Your code review is paramount for identifying extensibility
concerns, intent inaccuracies, maintainability issues, security flaws, and
unhandled edge cases.
